“Kala Se Kabiliyat Maine Siddh Ki Jaise Nawazuddin”
The story of Nawazuddin is one that instills hope, ambition, and determination in every young Indian that dares to dream beyond the boundaries that society tries to place upon him or her. The track follows the narrative thread of an artist's steadfast belief in their talent and how, despite all the odds stacked against them, the world finally submits to their genius and craft.
Music Credits
Written & Performed by Seedhe Maut
Produced by Hurricane
Mixed & Mastered by Bharg Kale
